verdict.rationale: Calendar-driven auto-capture is a fair question for a meeting recorder like Fathom, but the evidence pack never mentions connecting a Google or Outlook calendar or setting per-meeting-type capture rules. The only meeting-type reference is a read-only API filter for listing meetings after they are recorded, which is an adjacent feature and not a capture rule. Generic claims like "Unlimited meetings captured" and the bot or bot-free choice do not show calendar-based, rule-controlled auto-capture.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
